network_egress.red: The fleet-llm-d default-deny NetworkPolicy blocked pod DNS and HTTPS, so model artifact resolution timed out on both Arena workers.
network_egress.green: The embedding pod now has explicit egress only to cluster DNS on ports 53/5353 and HTTPS on port 443. Model artifacts downloaded successfully.

model_config_compatibility.red: The newest Nomic Transformers v5 revision exposed both legacy and new position fields and TEI rejected config.json as a duplicate max_position_embeddings field.
model_config_compatibility.green: The immediately preceding immutable Nomic revision uses the compatible Transformers v4 config and started without parser errors.

restart_behavior.red: No durable shared embedding cache had been proven.
restart_behavior.green: A deliberate Deployment restart reused the ReadWriteMany cache, downloaded model metadata in 4.5 ms, resolved ONNX weights from cache in 2.6 ms, and returned to Ready without a container restart.

agentops_knowledge_base_ingestion.reason: The earlier direct seat was reclaimed before the shared endpoint was available; ingestion must be repeated through a Launchpad-created seat.

test_strategy.TDD: A failing manifest contract preceded the compatible model revision and rollout-deadline changes; endpoint-source and missing-endpoint tests guard runtime injection.
test_strategy.EDD: This artifact records immutable source hashes, live HTTP behavior, cache timing, restart timing, concurrency, and isolation observations.
test_strategy.CDD: Catalog intake, generated catalog, cluster registry, runtime Secret resolver, and Arena model bundle agree on the named endpoint contract.
test_strategy.BDD: Given 25 simultaneous Launchpad-side callers, every request received a 768-dimensional embedding and the server remained Ready.
test_strategy.CBT: Manifest rendering, Arena admission, health, inference, persistent-cache restart, egress policy, and runtime injection were tested independently.

remaining_checks: AgentOps knowledge-base ingestion and semantic retrieval through a Launchpad-created seat
